# 2026-10-12 Shape: first release surface

## Captures

- [thought] (claude) Option "Laptop-only morning note". What it does: the agent on each laptop reads the person's own calendar entries, mail and documents, and an on-device model writes the 7:30 digest and the prep note; no meeting transcripts, no Zoom, no team dashboard. Where the work is done: on the person's device. Intune (Windows) pushes it first, Jamf (Mac) later if UNK-054 says so; consent and identity are the person's own Microsoft 365 sign-in plus the council-agreed data list. Costs: the digest is only as good as the on-device model (UNK-056), and for most meetings it has the calendar entry and no words from the call. Rules out: text off the laptop, a digest that follows the person between devices, adoption numbers. Merges the product owner's writer and the IT team's pushed agent into one package on the laptop, so the product owner and the endpoint lead must agree one release. → keep: [[04-solution-strategy|Solution strategy]] (assumption) ^c01
- [thought] (claude) Option "Cloud-written digest" (the product owner's one-pager). What it does: the agent on the laptop collects Teams, Zoom, Outlook and documents; a shared cloud service with a hosted language model writes the digest and prep note, which follow the person across devices; a team dashboard shows adoption by team. Where the work is done: collecting on the device, writing in a shared service, adoption in an admin view; consent and identity rest on a tenant app registration and tenant admin approval for transcripts. Costs: the CISO says they will not review a pack that sends text off the device (CST-003), so it cannot run before December 4, 2026 and may not run at all; it also needs a model vendor contract, an impact assessment and the council's agreement to the cloud list. Rules out: a pilot on February 2, 2027 unless the CISO changes their line. Merges collection, writing and adoption reporting under the product owner, who then answers the CISO, the DPO and the council for all three. → park ^c02
- [thought] (claude) Option "Calendar-first prep note". What it does: the smallest first release: on the laptop, the prep note ten minutes before each meeting, built only from the person's own calendar entries and mail headers by the on-device model; no morning digest, no documents, no transcripts. Where the work is done: on the person's device only; identity is their own sign-in; the data list the council reads is two lines long. Costs: it is a thin version of the CIO's ask (nothing "watches documents", no 7:30 digest) and the prep note may not be worth reading if headers say little. Rules out: the 7:30 digest, document reading, anything the DPO's naming rule would have to police (CST-004) in the first release. Keeps the writer, the packager and the dashboard separate for now, so the three owners meet later. → park ^c03
- [thought] (solution lead) "Option 1. Keeps February and the morning digest." Picked option 1, "Laptop-only morning note", which was Claude's preferred option, so it is promoted on a nod: origin `claude, from solution lead` for the pick itself. → keep: [[04-solution-strategy|Solution strategy]] (assumption) ^c04
- [thought] (claude, from solution lead) Rejected option 2, "Cloud-written digest": it rules out a February 2, 2027 pilot unless the CISO changes their line (^c02), and the lead chose the option that "keeps February". Reason inferred from the lead's words; to confirm. → keep: [[04-solution-strategy|Solution strategy]] (assumption) ^c05
- [thought] (claude, from solution lead) Rejected option 3, "Calendar-first prep note": it drops the 7:30 morning digest, and the lead chose the option that keeps "the morning digest". Reason inferred from the lead's words; to confirm. → keep: [[04-solution-strategy|Solution strategy]] (assumption) ^c06
- [thought] (solution lead) F1.6 (the full data list for the works council): "Works council for the data list". A pointer to who is involved; it does not say who writes the list, so UNK-057 (owner product owner) stays open. Open question for someone. → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#Question ledger|R-DAT-03]] (unknown) ^c07
- [thought] (solution lead) F1.31 (does the laptop-only agent need a tenant app registration): "endpoint lead on app registration". Open question for the IT endpoint lead; the vault's UNK-059 already has them as owner with @identity-lead to ask. → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#Question ledger|R-OPS-05]] (unknown) ^c08
- [thought] (solution lead) F1.27 (does the client-record question apply to a laptop digest): "legal on the client record question". Open question for legal counsel, as UNK-064. → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#Question ledger|R-REG-05]] (unknown) ^c09
- [thought] (solution lead) "CISO if there's doubt." The CISO is the fallback for any doubt about the pack or the registration review (UNK-058). → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#UNK-058 Security review pack|UNK-058]] (open) ^c10
- [thought] (solution lead) F1.32 (the on-device model trial): "The on-device model trial before January is the real gate". A belief the plan rests on, no source: that the trial is the gate for option 1. The lead asked who owns it; UNK-056 names @product-owner as owner of the question, but no one is recorded as running a trial. → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#Question ledger|R-OPS-06]] (unknown) ^c11
- [thought] (solution lead) "Rejection reasons yes." Confirms the reasons on `^c05` and `^c06` for options 2 and 3. → keep: [[04-solution-strategy|Solution strategy]] (assumption) ^c12
- [thought] (solution lead) F1.32: "Product owner owns the trial, they'll align with the endpoint lead." The product owner owns the on-device model trial for option 1; the alignment with the endpoint lead is the lead's expectation and not yet asked of either, so it is a belief. Waits on UNK-056. → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#UNK-056 On-device model quality|UNK-056]] (open) ^c13
- [thought] (solution lead) F1.6: "honestly not sure who writes it, that's the product owner and works council to sort." No one is recorded as writing the data list; the lead hands it to the product owner and the works council. A belief with no source, so UNK-057 stays open with its owner the product owner. → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#UNK-057 Full list of data Heron reads|UNK-057]] (open) ^c14
- [thought] (solution lead) "DPO if impact comes back." The DPO is consulted when the impact assessment returns (UNK-060), not before. → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#UNK-060 Impact assessment|UNK-060]] (open) ^c15
- [thought] (solution lead) "Client Delivery's the pilot, not a sign-off gate." Option 1 does not wait on Client Delivery's sign-off. This differs from UNK-065, which asks whether they sign off; the lead's view is a belief with no source, and UNK-065 stays open for the pilot lead. → keep: [[11-unknowns-and-risks#UNK-065 Client Delivery told what Heron surfaces|UNK-065]] (open) ^c16

[PTN] quote under four words: whether the Zoom agreement can be assigned. [REG] the quote did not mention its subject: lawful basis for attendees who did not switch Heron on. [OPS] the quote did not mention its subject: whether Heron retires anything.
- **Merged:** [OPS] into F1.4: Who are the named owners of the writer, the packager and the dashboard in each option? Who arbitrates between the product owner and the endpoint lead if they do not agree one release?
